 Oct 21, 2026 5:27PM
 Prabhas starrer Fauzi is gearing up for a special update on the occasion of the actor’s birthday on October 23. Mythri Movie Makers producer Ravi Shankar confirmed at the Donga Naa Koduku event that the makers will release a glimpse of the film, but clarified that it will not be a conventional teaser.
 According to Ravi, the video will introduce the world of Fauzi and establish some of its story elements. However, he did not reveal whether the glimpse will offer a look at Prabhas’ character or unveil his complete appearance in the film. He left the remaining details to be discovered when the video arrives.
 Written and directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, Fauzi stars Imanvi as the leading lady alongside Prabhas. The project has generated curiosity with its intriguing premise and the combination of the star actor with the director of Sita Ramam. So, the glimpse will be doing similar work like NTR's Dragon glimpse. Prashanth Neel is directing Dragon and makers seem to have chosen the same route to set up the world before revealing the entire story. 
 Producer confirmed that the glimpse will be played in theatres with 418 movie. Fauzi is reportedly being considered for a Summer 2027 release, but the makers have yet to confirm its theatrical date. For now, all eyes are on Prabhas’ birthday update and how much will it showcase the biggest star in action while introducing the world, its set in.
